test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: Identify the figure that does NOT belong to the following series.
solution:
The logic followed here is,

Logic: **(Sides in the inner image) + 1 = (Sides in the outer image).**

Let's check each option as per the logic,

1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b193a8d1a25f6e0fc3a394e46357bb5c9e8938256cba9fc118d8c2c61434a049.png] ⇒ (4) + 1 = (5)

2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cce5bac91d1d33f1f4cd78bb42f4c7ce7fc7c5d4317b9b69de3fbfa9ef95528e.png] → (6) + 1 ≠ 5 ⇒ Doesn't satisfy the logic.

3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e14c3b07966d3aae641e9cd1899301699dcc77ec0f2579245e2b6e3a5bf312d.png] ⇒ (3) + 1 = (4)

4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00a8b12118b97e419e16c4720e9256e42f99334ad7ceb2a1e382a10ad5474da3.png] ⇒ (5) + 1 = (6)

Here, we can see that only option 2 doesn't follow the logic and is different from the others.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
